notes.title: 🎉 New Update – Smarter Lobbies, Reconnect & Bug Fixes!
notes.content: [p]This update brings important improvements to the game experience:[/p][list][*][p]🔄 Clients can now [b]reconnect to lobbies[/b] if the game crashes (except when leaving manually).[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 When a game ends, [b]all players are sent back to the same lobby[/b] instead of the main menu – no more recreating lobbies each time![/p][/*][*][p]🎲 Fixed an issue where the [b]roll dice button didn’t appear initially[/b] for the first player.[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 Improved and corrected [b]Turkish translations[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Several other bug fixes and small improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy smoother games and better lobbies! 🚀[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Update Notes For August 24
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
We’ve just released a new update packed with improvements, bugfixes, and a bit of fun. This patch focuses on smoother gameplay and better localization support — plus we slipped in a new meme sound for you to enjoy.[/p][h3]📝 Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]🎲 Improved dice animation synchronization on clients (no more jittery or off timing).[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 Fixed place name localization on clients (place names now properly show in each player’s language).[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Several bugfixes for better stability.[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 Added a new meme sound: [i]Aaaugh[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 Improved UI for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your support and feedback — keep it coming![/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Major Update - August 18
notes.content: [p]Get ready for an enhanced gaming experience! This update brings [b]bets and predictions[/b], new animations, [b]character selection[/b], a refreshed [b]UI and main menu[/b], [b]new luck cards[/b], and more. Explore new features like [b]camera follow[/b], [b]re-roll on doubles[/b], and a [b]game timer[/b] that rewards the team with the highest total worth when time runs out. Plus, enjoy improved gameplay with bug fixes and visual enhancements.[/p][p]Update now and dive into the fun![/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Bets/Predictions[/b] for the next player's move.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]new animations[/b] for a more dynamic experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character selection[/b] is now available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved UI[/b] for easier navigation and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New main menu and lobby[/b] designs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]2 new luck cards[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tombstones[/b] added for bankrupted players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable starting money[/b] for more flexible rules.[/p][/*][*][p]Option to [b]escape prison by paying a fee[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera follow[/b] feature for active players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Re-roll when rolling doubles[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]turn indicator[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]bug fixes[/b] and performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game timer[/b] added – when time runs out, the team with the highest total worth wins.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613836/802b1134a717dd7c247fa45c18672675592966f6.png"][/img][/p]
